summary: R-1 HIGH / Core producer: establish the shared canonical coverage module-id contract for ProjectMap-backed coverage axes. Add/export a Core helper whose canonical form is exactly `target:{moduleName}:{modulePath}` when a module has usable name+path data, preserve already target-scoped ids, keep explicit fallback behavior for modules without usable paths, and avoid aggregate/root pollution. Apply the helper in Core coverage-axis construction so callers passing plain `module.id` plus `moduleName`/`modulePath` receive target-scoped ids. Add targeted tests for non-empty ProjectMap-like modules, already-target scoped ids, missing-path fallback, and aggregate/root handling. Do not change freeze literal values, R-2 ternary cleanup semantics, plugin/runtime host behavior, vendor snapshots, release metadata, or outer repos. Validate with Core targeted coverage tests plus `npm run build:check` (and broader `npm run check` if touched surface warrants it). Commit locally on main and backfill commit hash, commands, outputs, touched exports, compatibility/fallback notes, and downstream Alembic/AlembicPlugin consumption guidance.

targetTasks.summary: Implement Core canonical coverage module-id helper/contract for `target:{moduleName}:{modulePath}` and make Core coverage-axis construction use it with tests and local commit.
